alerts.reason: Cato’s reported sales growth slowed from 23.53% in July to 14.21% in October. That cushion supports a forecast that the intervening quarter stays above −5.00%. The target quarter beginning January 30 then compares with the prior spring, when stimulus and reopening helped lift sales (A, B). I expect those benefits to be difficult to repeat and forecast a new decline of at least 5.00% year over year in the target quarter.
